offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty property and casualty insurance for businesses and healthcare organizations. It distributes coverage through insurance brokers and evaluates risks that can be difficult to insure in the standard market.

primary_products.value: primary general liability insurance; excess casualty insurance; management liability insurance; errors and omissions insurance; healthcare professional liability insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial businesses, financial institutions, hospitals, senior care providers and managed care organizations

end_markets.value: construction; real estate; manufacturing; financial services; healthcare

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums for assuming commercial casualty, professional liability and healthcare liability risks

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: pools premiums and assumes liability risks for businesses and healthcare organizations

specialization.value: related lines: commercial casualty, professional liability, healthcare liability and coverage for smaller hard-to-insure businesses

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: wholesale and retail insurance brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state insurance departments oversee licensing, insurer solvency and surplus lines placement
